messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — opened PR #4123 to remove stale route table associations in gpu-subnet-1/2. terraform plan looks clean but this touches prod RTs. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4123
Priya Nair: On it, will try to review before EOD :eyes:
Samir Patel: Quick q — does this change any routes used by dedicated clusters? If so we should schedule a merge window and notify SREs.
Alex Chen: Good question — no route modifications, only destroying associations for deprecated peering (peering-olap-2). Verified connectivity in staging. plan snippet: ```~ aws_route_table_association.old_assoc (destroy)```
infra-ci: terraform plan succeeded for PR #4123 — no drifts detected. plan id: plan-abc123. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/infra/plan/plan-abc123
Jamie Ortiz: I can approve but prefer merge during low traffic (02:00-04:00 UTC). @Alex Chen can you add a canary / rollback step to the runbook? :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Yep — adding a small canary flag and a rollback section to the runbook. Pushing update now.
Priya Nair: LGTM after Alex's update. ping me when ready to merge.
Samir Patel: Left one nit about terraform resource naming (non-blocking). Otherwise looks fine.
Alex Chen: Updated naming and runbook. Will run `terraform apply -target=aws_route_table_association` in staging first to sanity-check.
infra-ci: CI checks: fmt ✅, tflint ✅, plan ✅, integration-staging ✅
Priya Nair: Approved.
Jamie Ortiz: Approved. Schedule looks good.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — scheduling merge at 02:30 UTC and I'll be on-call for the rollout. Will post post-merge health check when done.
